name: print-social-mental-health-podcast-posts-blue-violet-pink-gradients
title: Mind Matters podcast pack with blue-violet-pink gradients, rounded photo panels and sparkle stars
whatItIs: Five posts on deep blue to violet to pink gradients with rounded photo panels of podcast hosts at microphones, bold white headlines ('Embark on a Journey Within', 'Real Stories, Real Impact'), large sparkle stars, half-circle shapes and a hashtag footer.
whatItMeans: Soothing yet contemporary; dreamy gradients match the introspective topic.
techniques: Use a cool-to-warm gradient to suggest calm and hope.
Put hosts in rounded photo panels.
Use a big sparkle as a spark-of-insight motif.

vocabulary.definition: A soft multi-hue gradient like northern lights.
